mechanism_portfolio.natural_reading: in build on the shortlist and Done on the ticket means in the pool
final on the art ticket and sent on the tracker means nothing is owed
the ticket description is the item's effect
sent on the tracker means accepted
the default set is the one in the design-channel decision
the shortlist tab is the candidate list
every sound cue the tracker lists as ready goes in the pack
